name: cobalt-capabilities
description: Explicit optional Hindsight memory and Obscura browser companion for Cobalt Cockpit. Not part of the v0.3.2 directory submission.

memoryEnabled.title: Enable memory companion
memoryEnabled.description: Permit explicit memory operations against an independently configured Hindsight service.

browserEnabled.title: Enable browser companion
browserEnabled.description: Permit bounded browser tasks against an independently isolated Obscura service.

configurationPath.title: Operator configuration file
configurationPath.description: Absolute path to a private operator-owned JSON file. Both capability switches must also be enabled in this file.
